scripts.dev:all: npx concurrently -n frontend,backend,mongo -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run mongo:start"
scripts.install:all: cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.test:all: cd frontend && npm test && cd ../backend && npm test
